name: n8n workflow diagnosis and repair dataset
provenance: Original synthetic diagnostic cases. v0.2 training and former-validation records were reviewed and normalized; three mismatched examples were replaced. The v0.3 validation and evaluation splits use separately authored scenario templates and varied node types, parameters, errors, payloads, version-context notices and workflow graphs. No customer workflows, production exports or real secrets are included.
format: JSONL chat messages: system, user, assistant

archived_benchmark.note: Preserved unchanged for historical comparison only. Not used for training, validation, or v0.3 evaluation.

design.training: 640 examples balanced to 80 per category. This split contains 197 retained v0.2 training examples, 50 former v0.2 validation examples after diagnosis-label normalization, and 393 new or replacement synthetic cases.
design.validation: 128 newly authored cases, 16 per category. Scenario templates are separately authored from the retained training examples.
design.evaluation: 192 newly authored held-out cases, 24 per category and four per canonical diagnosis code. Scenario templates differ from the retained v0.2 training cases and the newly authored training templates; keep untouched and do not use for tuning.
design.diagnosis_codes: 48 canonical labels: six per category, explicitly listed in diagnosis-codes.json and in the system instruction.
design.retrieval: The same retrieved official documentation is provided to training, validation, and evaluation prompts to avoid a train/evaluation context mismatch.
design.safety: Credentials and secrets always abstain. External outages and ambiguous item lineage abstain unless supplied evidence supports a safe, minimal correction.
design.limits: Synthetic benchmark; not representative of all real n8n failures. Patch applicability checks the JSON fixture and workflow graph only; it does not execute n8n. A gold-patch match is strict and may penalize alternative valid repairs.
design.item_linking: A missing paired-item link may be repaired with .first() only when the prompt explicitly guarantees exactly one upstream item; otherwise it must abstain and request human review.

validation: 128 newly authored cases, 16 per category, separate from training.
